shape_construction: Believable task-specific proportions, silhouettes, construction, joins and object anatomy. Generic boxes, disconnected pipes, floating parts and unclosed architectural gaps are substantive defects. Judge intended stylization, not polygon count.
materials: Appropriate authored material vocabulary, scale, surface differentiation and consistency. Default/checker surfaces, indiscriminate tiling and texture pasted over primitive geometry do not establish finish. Do not demand wear where not requested.
lighting: Exposure, readable surfaces, shadow depth, light/material relationships across all important zones. Burnt-out whites, persistent darkness, flat unreadable surfaces and pervasive glare lower quality even if objects exist.
composition: Spatial hierarchy, focal readability, coherent massing and purposeful distribution at overview, street/room and close scales. Empty space is not inherently bad; unjustified barren requested working or inhabited zones are.
detail: Meaningful task-specific equipment, furnishing and environmental detail at large/medium/small scales. Repeated colored boxes, labels and token props cannot stand in for differentiated functional objects or rich requested spaces.
style: Match the requested/reference visual language across all zones. Real environments require plausible construction and material treatment; voxel/game styles require intentional resolved abstraction. Do not penalize coherent low-poly/voxel design for not being photorealistic.
scene_coverage: Substantive realization of the public brief and reference scene extent, connected zones, context and principal architectural/environmental features. Judge the realized scene, not merely presence counts or labels. Avoid requiring identical camera or incidental photograph clutter.
functional_identity: Visible differentiation and credible furnishing of required functional areas and mechanisms. A named room with token objects is partial credit. Compare defining reference features when supplied. Do not infer actual interactive success from appearance.

formula: continuous quality anchored to visible completion; coverage and deviation retained separately as diagnostics

environment.criterion: Reconcile all four references as one compact kitchen, preserving the relationships between the window worktop, cooking corner, refrigerator wall, dining corner and doorway.
Match the strong warm daylight filtered through orange-red blinds, with narrow striped shadows, bright window-side surfaces and substantially darker interior corners.

features.criterion: Tall tiled walls, substantial doorway reveals and a narrow recessed area frame the compact kitchen.
Wall tiling uses elongated rectangular units in alternating vertical arrangements; the floor uses smaller staggered rectangular tiles.
A doorway beside the appliance wall includes a pale vertical-bar security gate and a small upper glazed opening.
Cream-to-ochre wall tiles, tan floor tiles, dark brown skirting and pale ceiling trim establish the room's finishes.
A long window-side worktop turns into the cooking corner, with base cupboards below and upper cupboards concentrated around the cooking area.
The opposite wall combines a tall oven housing, a short counter beneath a microwave recess and tall storage beside the refrigerator.
Flat pale cabinet fronts have narrow darker edging and small curved brown handles, with horizontal drawer fronts among taller doors.
Glossy honey-brown wood-grain worktops contrast with cream cabinet faces and darker recessed plinths.
A broad rectangular window dominates the wall above the worktop and dining corner.
Closely spaced horizontal Venetian slats span the glazing, with visible vertical cords and a slim pale surround.
Orange-red slats transmit intense warm light through narrow gaps.
Decorative metal security grille curves remain partially visible behind the blinds.
A tall white refrigerator has two stacked doors, broad horizontal handles and an irregular scatter of magnets and paper notes.
The cooking counter contains a dark four-ring electric hob beneath a projecting angular dark extractor hood.
Two stacked black glazed appliance fronts occupy the tall left housing; a separate microwave sits in an open recess near the refrigerator.
White countertop appliance bodies, stainless vessels and black glass provide distinct finishes against the pale cabinetry.
A compact rectangular wooden table occupies the window-side dining corner.
Chairs have thick cylindrical upright posts and broad curved horizontal back rails.
Warm reddish-brown polished timber and patterned upholstered seats distinguish the dining furniture.
Checked cloths drape over chair backs, with a dark green bag hanging from another chair.

targets.label: Dining table and substantial wooden chairs

features.criterion: Condiment jars and cylindrical containers cluster along the window-side worktop rather than forming evenly spaced decoration.
A dark rectangular electric tray with a loose cord and a red patterned mat occupy the counter beside the hob.
Hanging mugs beneath the microwave and suspended cooking utensils beside the hob reinforce the crowded working kitchen.
The dining tabletop holds a tissue box, a large clear jar with a dark lid, a shallow dish and assorted small containers.
Yellow and pale lidded buckets sit at floor level in the recessed passage area.
